caption: The video captures a pink, rose-swirl candle burning inside a metal cup whose handle projects to the right, the cup resting on a flat black surface before a plain white wall. A dark vertical rod stands behind the cup, and pale green surfaces border the left and right edges. A pool of melted pink wax rings the base of the candle within the cup. The wick's flame is already burning and stays alight throughout, its shape and orientation changing constantly as it flickers. At moments the flame stretches tall and leans rightward toward the background rod, while at others it shortens, broadens, or tilts left, its brightness swelling and dimming over time. Aside from the flame, the candle body, wick stub and surrounding objects show no noticeable displacement, leaving the restless dance of the flame as the most pronounced motion.
